comparison.objective: Place nail plates only over stud holes whose edges are too close to the stud face.
comparison.physical_skill: Visually measure hole depth and place plates flat and centered.
comparison.success_condition: Correct qualifying studs are plated and no others are; the source gives the 31.75 mm selection threshold but no placement tolerances.
comparison.reason: This is threshold-based inspection and planar placement, with no impact, intentional fracture, retained insert, or fragment recovery.
